title: TwoSum
question: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Assume exactly one solution exists.

title: InsertNodeInBST
question: Given the root node of a binary search tree (BST) and a value to insert, insert the value into the BST such that the tree remains a valid BST. Return the root of the tree after insertion.

title: CheckAnagramInBST
question: Given two binary trees, determine whether they are level-wise anagrams of each other. This means that for every level, the two trees must contain the same node values with the same frequencies, regardless of order. Return true if all corresponding levels match, otherwise false.

title: ReversalOrder
question: Given the root of a binary tree, return its reverse level order traversal. The traversal should process nodes from the bottommost level up to the root, and within each level from left to right.

title: ArrayToBinaryTree
question: Given a list of integers representing the level order traversal of a complete binary tree, construct the binary tree and return its root. The list is indexed such that for a node at index i, its left child is at 2*i+1 and its right child is at 2*i+2.

title: BinaryTreeFromPreorderAndInorder
question: Given two integer arrays preorder and inorder representing the preorder and inorder traversal of a binary tree, construct and return the binary tree. You may assume there are no duplicate values in the tree.

title: ChildernSum
question: Given the root of a binary tree, check whether it satisfies the children sum property. For every node except leaf nodes, the node's value must equal the sum of its left and right children's values, treating a missing child as 0.
